title: What Do LLM Judges Actually Verify? Matched Controls and Record Gaps for Document Currency
abstract: arXiv:2611.01311v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: LLM judges often check, against an amendment record, whether the documents an answer cites are still in force. Such records are rarely complete. From a table of replacements, our test generates matched answers citing a replaced document, its successor, the replaced document before its replacement, and an older document that a newer one updated without replacing; it removes links from the record and scores each finding by its stated reason. On 48 replacements from the IETF RFC index, judges given a correct record caught nearly every replaced citation, as a lookup would. On the 24 faults whose link we removed, every judge caught more from the texts alone than with the record: Gemini 3.1 Pro 23/24 against 1/24, GPT-5.5 23/24 against 9/24, Claude Opus 4.5 17/24 against 9/24 and Gemma 4 26B 13/24 against 0/24. translated_title: LLM 评判器究竟在验证什么？面向文档时效性的匹配对照与记录缺口
translated_abstract: LLM 评判器常常依据修订记录检查答案所引用的文档是否仍然有效，而这类记录很少是完整的。基于一张替换表，我们的测试生成了匹配的答案，分别引用被替换的文档、其继任文档、被替换之前的原文档，以及被更新但未被替换的较旧文档；测试从记录中移除链接，并根据评判器陈述的理由对每个发现进行评分。在来自 IETF RFC 索引的 48 个替换案例中，获得正确记录的评判器几乎捕捉到了每一个被替换的引用，表现如同简单的表查询。在我们移除链接的 24 个故障案例中，每个评判器仅凭文档文本捕获的数量都多于使用记录时：Gemini 3.1 Pro 为 23/24 对 1/24，GPT-5.5 为 23/24 对 9/24，Claude Opus 4.5 为 17/24 对 9/24，Gemma 4 26B 为 13/24 对 0/24。这一下降在第二次移除链接的抽样中再次出现。大多数遗漏没有附带任何发现；在引入冲突代码的探索性运行中，仅……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文通过构造引用被替换文档、继任文档、替换前文档及“被更新而未替换”文档的匹配对照答案，并在修订记录中故意移除链接，揭示出 LLM 评判器主要依赖文本内容而非修订记录来验证文档时效性——记录缺失时，各评判器仅凭文本反而捕获了更多失效引用。
en_tdlr: Using matched control answers and deliberately gapped amendment records, this paper shows that LLM judges catch stale citations better from document texts alone than from the record itself, revealing that they verify textual inconsistency rather than truly consulting currency records.
